similarities.point: Both texts identify the subject as Cabidos.
similarities.quote_britannica: CABIDOS, or CAXIVOS, a long mesmer

differences.point: Britannica describes Cabidos as a unit of measure in Portuguese India, while Wikipedia describes it as a French commune.
differences.quote_britannica: a long mesmer called at Goa, and in other places of the Rall India belonging to the Portuguele
differences.quote_wikipedia: is a commune in the Pyrénées-Atlantiques department in south-western France.

claims.claim: Cabidos is equal to 40 Paris ells.
claims.quote_britannica: no mesure fluffs, linens, Gv, and equal to 40 the Paris elt.
